dimension.definition: Primary documentary subject, not exclusive relevance.

claim_type.definition: Source speech act, not truth or verified deployment.

event_date.definition: Event date or stated interval; Unknown is substantive, not missing.

allowed: Document-specific; no wider version or coverage inference
current_version_match.definition: Version/scope distinction; explain which construct drives choice.

independent_outcome_verified.definition: Whether reviewed evidence establishes independent verification, not global absence.

document_date.definition: Publication/effective date as defined in notes; Unknown when not established after adequate review.

document_association_scope.definition: Candidate case-source association, not assumed applicability.

coverage_presence.definition: Relevant corpus evidence, not verified implementation; may expose primary-dimension allocation mismatch.
coverage_presence.comparison_limit: Legacy A records primary-dimension allocation; B audits relevant corpus evidence. Treat matches/disagreements as construct diagnostics, not intercoder reliability, until A is recoded under the same rubric.

amount_text.definition: Independent source monetary transcription; exact match is only format agreement.

finance_stage.definition: Source financial stages; multiple allowed except singleton Not established.

governance_link_type.definition: Independent scope judgment for a candidate instrument-system pair.

compliance_verified.definition: Reviewed evidence of compliance, not inference from a policy's existence.

missing_rule: Only coded-coded pairs are scored; substantive Unknown/Not established are valid codes where defined.
